semantics.air3: Third aerial light hit; automatically followed by a separate slam action.
semantics.slam: Downward strike after air3; separate damage event and downward launch.
semantics.chargeRelease: Transitions directly into blow/launch/ranged/rush; no additional cancel action.
semantics.tetsu/blow: Standalone charged strong only: original MOB slash, 1.0 action seconds; four active windows [0.16,0.34), [0.34,0.52), [0.52,0.70), [0.70,0.88). Body is separate from M/MO/MOB/burst FX. FX playback spans 0.72 seconds; phase boundaries at 0.18 second intervals. Normal and awakened clips each require 16+ independent frames.

addressing: hero normal keys are unprefixed; other characters use denden/, nyoro/, tetsu/. Awakened keys add awakened- before the motion name. FX use hero/effects/, denden/effects/, etc.; shared fallback is effects/.
notes: Phase aliases share the same full 16+ frame source clip; no duplicated textures are required.
Frame duration is seconds; rect, pivot and bodyHeight are pixels.
Sources inside an adapter resolve relative to that adapter JSON.
Combat timing, hit detection, damage, movement and release events are game-owned, not inferred from pixels.
Frame-address checks do not prove unique drawings or final visual quality; inspect supplied pixels.
Old six ZIPs and legacy pixel art are not approved final cartoon animation.

mobSlashLayers.body: tetsu/blow (or tetsu/awakened-blow), without baked blade trail or letters
rules: Each layer and awakened variant needs 16+ independent frame addresses and transparency.
Letters playback is restricted to the current combat phase; burst begins at action age .70, with the fourth hit and launch.
Provide phaseRanges m/mo/mob/burst for other frame counts; absent ranges default to four equal index partitions.

Frame pivot is in source pixels. Optional clip socket:{offset:[x,y],size:N} uses logical game pixels relative to the stated anchor; x mirrors with facing. Socket size overrides the default longest dimension.
Socket is a fixed attachment offset, not a per-frame skeletal bone. Body scale is 110 logical pixels high.
Do not combine these layers into generic hit-heavy or the superseded mob-slash key.
Legacy body/letters remain provisional fallbacks until complete layer sets arrive.

manny.bodyHeight: Required source-pixel body height EXCLUDING hat; approved measurement 275px. Per-character displayBodyHeight=80 logical px. Keep source measurement unchanged; hat may extend above it. Missing bodyHeight renders placeholder.
manny.design: Green-trim black witch hat, gold round glasses, black face, pink paw staff
manny.special2: Raise staff and release giant red-blue energy orb

mobdesert.design: Beige wrapped clothes, red scarf and sneakers, gold round glasses, black face, curved sword
mobdesert.special1: Jump spin slash plus purple fish, 4 normal / 7 awakened
mobdesert.special2: Raise sword and summon huge purple smoke dragon

rejectedAssets.light1: Previous weak1 artwork rejected for unnatural arm anatomy. Do not connect as final artwork; replacement 16-frame shoulder/elbow/wrist/grip correction pending.

newCharacters.bodyKeys: manny/<motion>, mobdesert/<motion>; awakened- prefix. Same 16+ frame requirement for every source motion and independent FX. Special body phases use special1-startup/active/recovery and special2-startup/active/recovery. No stage changes.
newCharacters.displaySizing: Runtime profile displayBodyHeight overrides default 110; Manny=80, other characters=110. Source bodyHeight is measured independently and must not be altered to tune display scale.

textureMemory.accounting: width*height*4 decoded RGBA, plus 256x256 retained-pose canvas and in-flight reservation; not total browser/GPU/process memory
priority: selected character/form idle and current motion
walk, light1-4, dash, jump, charge-start/hold; first page only
other pages and FX on demand
textureMemory.eviction: Demand LRU; speculative prefetch never evicts decoded assets; context switch aborts requests, closes old ImageBitmaps and discards retained pose.
textureMemory.runtimeFormat: Static PNG or lossless WebP: RIFF/VP8L, VP8X containing VP8L; dimensions verified before decode. Lossy VP8, animated WebP, malformed chunks, inconsistent dimensions and oversized files fail closed. Encoded size<=64MiB, chunks<=1024, dimensions<=4096, decoded atlas<=64MiB minus retained-pose allowance.
textureMemory.failure: 30s backoff; at most3 attempts per retained failure record; failure map128, diagnostics50; no unresolved image promises kept
textureMemory.packing: Trim per frame, 4-8px padding, arbitrary rects and per-frame pivots supported. Keep16+ addresses. Scale rect/pivot/bodyHeight to the same runtime-pixel coordinate system; displayBodyHeight remains game units.
textureMemory.fallback: Decoded idle or one 256x256 same-character/form last pose while demanded frame loads; existing provisional renderer if no pose has loaded. No seamless final-art guarantee before asset/device tests.

displaySize.unit: multiples of selected character displayBodyHeight (Manny80, other110)
displaySize.fallback: clip socket.size or effect caller size, using legacy longest-edge scaling

socketOffset.unit: multiples of selected character displayBodyHeight, relative to effect call anchor
socketOffset.validation: both finite with absolute value<=32; negative allowed
socketOffset.orientation: X mirrors with facing; Y unchanged and positive down
socketOffset.fallback: clip socket.offset in logical game px, otherwise [0,0]

fxFrameLayout.pivot: trimmed rect-local runtime pixels; outside-rect values supported; scaled separately by display width/rect width and display height/rect height
fxFrameLayout.aspect: displaySize sets exact width and height. Export ratio matching rect width/height to preserve aspect; engine does not infer original untrimmed canvas size.
fxFrameLayout.scope: FX rendering only. Normalized per-frame fields survive pages and aliases. Each property overrides independently only when present.
fxFrameLayout.exampleNote: Example shows one frame; real source requires16+ independently addressed frames.

fxOrientation.orientationMode: Optional clip field: velocity | facing | fixed. Omitted: binding default (moving shots velocity, ground splash and Manny orb fixed, others facing). Explicit fixed bindings override clip metadata.
fxOrientation.nativeAngleRadians: Optional clip field, default0; finite abs<=2PI. Native image travel direction in image coordinates (+X right,+Y down), positive clockwise. Used only in velocity mode.
fxOrientation.velocity: rotate(atan2(vy,vx)-nativeAngleRadians) around pivot; NO additional mirror. vx sign determines socket X direction; if vx=0 use stored shot direction. Zero velocity: no rotation.
fxOrientation.facing: horizontal mirror by supplied event/action/player direction, no rotation; ignores nativeAngleRadians.
fxOrientation.fixed: no rotation or mirror. Splash and Manny orb locked fixed.
fxOrientation.transformOrder: World anchor + [dir*socketOffsetX, socketOffsetY], then rotation OR mirror, then draw with pivot subtracted. Socket axes stay world-facing, not rotated; Y unchanged. Pivot maps exactly to the offset anchor.
fxOrientation.dragon: Exporter supplies measured left/left-down nativeAngleRadians; no guessed constant or position-offset substitution.
fxOrientation.heroGroundOffsets: Caller anchors unchanged. Exporter may use bottom-center pivot and socketOffsetY charge50/110, launch45/110, slam15/110, aura55/110, burst50/110, splash0. Do not apply compensation again in binding.

bombVariants.selection: spawn index modulo5: normal5 once each, awakened8 cycles pink/cyan/green
bombVariants.fallback: Same-form special1-bomb generic if variant metadata absent or texture not yet loaded. Character-specific key then shared effects key for each variant/generic.
bombVariants.art: Separate actual drawings per color,16+ independent frame addresses per track. No runtime tint or whole-group sprite duplicated onto each projectile.

releaseBinding.schemaLocation: Body clip metadata: ranged; special2-active (water); special1-active/special2-active for unique specials. Same character/form prefix as body. If active phase clip absent, action-type body clip is fallback.
releaseBinding.releaseSocket: Optional [x,y] in displayBodyHeight units; finite abs<=32. Actual projectile origin = event-time feet + [action.dir*x*height,y*height]. height=Manny80, others110. Not a visual-only offset.
releaseBinding.releaseFrame: Optional zero-based source frame index, integer0..frames.length-1. Export actual source index, not one-based sheet cell label. Maps body playback to that frame at game-owned release time; phase aliases must include that source frame to apply synchronization.
releaseBinding.multiprojectile: All projectiles in one emission share the specified socket when present; speed differences/delays retained. Without metadata all old per-projectile origins/formations stay unchanged.
releaseBinding.fx: Projectile FX socketOffset should be [0,0]; anchor is actual projectile position. No automatic compensation or changes to existing assets.

dendenDowncastReference.note: Socket relative to virtual root mapped to world player P, not visible airborne feet or ground.

releaseBinding.dendenFrameNumbering: Confirmed sheet cells are one-based: ranged cell8 -> releaseFrame7; downcast cell5 -> releaseFrame4.

mobSlashTiming.letters: 0.16-.88 action seconds; four phase ranges0.16/.34/.52/.70; per-phase elapsed = actionAge-boundary, duration.18. 16 frames duration.045 each,4 per phase. Hidden before.16 and from.88.
mobSlashTiming.boundaryRule: Shared explicit comparisons for damage/FX, avoiding floor rounding at.70.

authoredRootLift.scope: Optional body-frame metadata; not clip-level and ignored by FX rendering.
authoredRootLift.unit: Signed ratio of display body height (manny 80 logical px, others 110), not atlas pixels.
authoredRootLift.meaning: Positive means upward displacement baked into the image relative to a fixed ground baseline; move the body image down to cancel it. Negative moves it up.
authoredRootLift.validation: Finite number from -32 through 32 inclusive; absent means zero. Invalid values reject the animation.
authoredRootLift.invariants: Independent of facing and grounded state; preserve in cached fallback pose. Never modify physics, collision or releaseSocket/projectile coordinates.
